label: StudyORIN-REC part2 analysis
design: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on Jetson AGX Orin, default Jetson vLLM config (enforce-eager, max-num-seqs 1, prefix caching ON, FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=1), mm-processor-kwargs matched to the committed ACC2 robot requests (shortest_edge 4096, do_sample_frames false; no downscale, no resample), image cap raised 21->640 for RICH histories. One request at a time, idle. Full S-EMBER recall suite, DEV and EVAL, both representations: RECENT (last 120 s) and D2/RICH (full D2 history). Requests are COLD (fresh run tag / salt / uuids), so cached_tokens is absent by design. Over-context questions are reported as such, never truncated.
agreement_note: Paired per question_id with the committed StudyACC2 A6000 proxy (results/sember/study_acc2/acc2_requests.jsonl), reported per (rep,split), NEVER pooled. Agreement = fraction where the device letter equals the proxy letter on the question_id intersection; over_context device rows carry no answer and are excluded. proxy_missing was 0 in every cell.
latency_note: RECENT is the cold single-turn path: TTFT p50 3.317 s is frame prefill (matches StudyORIN-REC part1 cold TTFT 3.296 s and the SH-EP cold path). D2/RICH TTFT scales with history (p50 6.86 s, p90 16.83 s, up to 338 frames / 30,583 prompt tokens). Prefix caching is ON in the deployment but each request uses a fresh salt, so no request is served warm; see StudyORIN-REC WARM for the best-case warm latency.

over_context.policy: reported as over-context, never silently truncated (D146)

cached_tokens_note: COLD run: cached_tokens present on 0/1690 requests, nonzero on 0/1690. Expected (fresh salt per request).

consistency_checks.cross_check_prompt_tokens: RECENT prompt_tokens p50 = 5524, exactly the committed ACC2 RECENT median (parity target 5,476-5,682). mm-processor config parity confirmed.
consistency_checks.positive_control_proxy: A6000 proxy committed accuracy reproduced from acc2_requests.jsonl: D2 DEV 0.3704, D2 EVAL 0.3738, RECENT DEV 0.3663, RECENT EVAL 0.3272; these match proxy_acc_on_paired up to the over_context exclusion.
consistency_checks.dedup: The runner was resumed from index 205 after the WARM insert; 2 questions straddling the boundary (D2/EVAL 0C17EAFE8AE5, 0EC4CF418993, both over_context) were written twice. Deduped by (rep,question_id) keeping first occurrence: 1692 -> 1690 rows. This also resolved the RECENT/D2 EVAL count asymmetry (both 602). Recording artifact of the resume, not a methodological change.
consistency_checks.frames_missing: total frames_missing across all requests = 2 (recorded per row).

headline: On the full S-EMBER recall suite the 4B device model scores 0.27-0.29 across both representations and splits, a few points below the A6000 proxy (0.33-0.38), and agrees with the proxy's letter on about half the questions (0.50-0.54). RICH history does not beat RECENT on the device (D2 vs RECENT within CI on both splits) while costing ~2x the TTFT and pushing 6 EVAL questions over the 32768-token context.
